definitions.gloss: phasing out nuclear power; moving away from nuclear power
definitions.explanation: The policy or movement of ending dependence on nuclear power plants and shutting them down. Widely debated in Japan after the Fukushima Daiichi accident of 2011; also used before a noun for people and groups who hold this position.

examples.japanese: {脱原発|だつげんぱつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訴|うった}える→訴える：01891_uttaeru⟧。
examples.english: To call for an end to nuclear power.

examples.japanese: ⟦ドイツ→ドイツ：30813_doitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{脱原発|だつげんぱつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{実現|じつげん}→実現：03276_jitsugen⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Germany has completed its phase-out of nuclear power.

examples.japanese: ⟦{震災|しんさい}→震災：14610_shinsai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{脱原発|だつげんぱつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧⟦デモ→デモ：19416_demo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: After the earthquake disaster, demonstrations calling for an end to nuclear power were held across the country.

notes:
From the prefix ⟦{脱|だつ}→脱〜：31355_datsu⟧〜 (moving away from, de-) and ⟦{原発|げんぱつ}→原発：11943_genpatsu⟧ (nuclear power plant). The same prefix appears in ⟦{脱炭素|だつたんそ}→脱炭素：06410_datsutanso⟧ (decarbonization) and ⟦{脱|だつ}サラ→脱サラ：29183_datsusara⟧ (quitting salaried work).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {脱原発|だつげんぱつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訴|うった}える→訴える：01891_uttaeru⟧ / ⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧: to call for an end to nuclear power
- {脱原発|だつげんぱつ}⟦{派|は}→派：28356_ha⟧: the anti-nuclear camp
- {脱原発|だつげんぱつ}⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧: a nuclear phase-out policy

RELATED WORDS:
- {反原発|はんげんぱつ}: opposed to nuclear power (stresses opposition rather than a gradual phase-out)
- ⟦{再稼働|さいかどう}→再稼働：29736_saikadou⟧: restarting (of reactors)
